stories.title: Betsi staff afraid to speak out, review finds, as Unite says managers failed to listen
stories.summary: Staff at Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board are afraid to speak out or raise concerns, an independent review of the north Wales health board has found. The Independent Well-Led Review, published on Tuesday, described the board’s governance as “immature and ineffective”. stories.title: Welsh Government spent £30,000 asking where a parent’s job ends and a school’s begins, and only five took part
stories.summary: Twenty parents expressed interest in research meant to help define where a parent's job ends and a school's begins, but only five took part.

stories.title: Timms Review: Changes to disability benefit could affect 12,000 people in Flintshire
stories.summary: More than 12,000 people in Flintshire who get Personal Independence Payment (PIP) could see changes to how the benefit is assessed and paid, after a government review published today set out plans to overhaul it. stories.title: Betsi review offers first clear path to improvement, says minister
stories.summary: Health Minister Mabon ap Gwynfor plans to appoint three new board members to deliver the review's 21 recommendations, with actions due within six months.
